schemes.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (PM-USP CSSS)
schemes.summary: Central government merit scholarship for regular college and university students who scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12, with family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh a year. Rs 12,000 per year for the first three years of undergraduate study and Rs 20,000 per year at postgraduate level (or the 4th/5th year of professional courses), paid by direct benefit transfer. Applications are free and made only on the National Scholarship Portal.
schemes.benefit_period: per year (UG years 1-3; Rs 20,000 for PG / 4th-5th year)
eligibility: Above the 80th percentile in the Class 12 board exam
Regular full-time UG or PG course at a recognised institution
Family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh per year
Not receiving another scholarship for the same period
schemes.source: PM-USP CSSS guidelines, Department of Higher Education (Ministry of Education); National Scholarship Portal

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.summary: Central government income support for landholding farmer families: Rs 6,000 per year paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 by direct benefit transfer to Aadhaar-linked bank accounts. Registration and e-KYC are free on the official portal or at Common Service Centres.
eligibility: Aadhaar-linked bank account and completed e-KYC
Income-tax payers, institutional landholders and some pensioners are excluded
schemes.source: pmkisan.gov.in; Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (amount confirmed for 2026-27)

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.summary: Cashless hospital cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care at empanelled hospitals, for economically vulnerable families; senior citizens aged 70+ also get Rs 5 lakh cover (Ayushman Vay Vandana). The Ayushman card and treatment are free.
eligibility: Families identified in SECC 2011 and state lists
All senior citizens aged 70 and above
No cap on family size or age
schemes.source: National Health Authority (nha.gov.in); Lok Sabha reply, 24 July 2026
